integrity.reconstruction_note: All 30 teams sit at or below the snapshot, which is the expected direction when 19 games are missing from the captured history. 0 teams exceed their snapshot, which would indicate a transcription error somewhere.

ats.note: Self-consistency only: the line is ours, so this is not a market test. No odds feed exists, so no ROI or CLV can be computed and none is shown.

model_vs_better_net.note: difference in hit rate on the same games; paired values are not independent, so treat p as indicative

tiers.note: no games in this tier in the sample

margin_total.verdict: no detectable relationship at this sample size

legs.interpretation: The two legs are treated as independent by naive parlay pricing. The observed difference is what a same-game parlay would be mispriced by BEFORE any vig; a z below about 2 means this sample cannot yet separate it from noise.
legs.note: Pushes are impossible on these numbers only if the line is a half point; half-point increments are enforced by the line builder, so no push handling is needed here.

cross_game.note: Pairs within the same date only. Overlapping pairs are not independent, so this r is indicative.

rest.note: Rest is derived from official game dates only. A negative b2b margin would support the fatigue story; the p-value says whether this sample can see it.

G-01.name: Sample size
G-01.registered_rule: >= 300 settled bets for team markets; >= 500 for player props.
G-01.why_it_matters: At this sample a 63% hit rate and a 52% hit rate cannot be told apart. The leaderboard ranks noise until this gate passes.

G-02.name: Closing line value (CLV)
G-02.registered_rule: Mean CLV vs. closing number > 0 with a bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0.
G-02.required: > 0 mean closing line value with a bootstrap CI excluding 0
G-02.why_it_matters: Our number can be compared with the outcome, but not with the price. Without a licensed odds feed no CLV, ROI or stake exists. Nothing on this site is a value bet and no ROI is published.

G-03.name: Probability calibration
G-03.registered_rule: Brier score <= 0.245 on settled games AND calibration slope in [0.85, 1.15] AND intercept in [-0.10, 0.10].
G-03.why_it_matters: A Brier score below the 50% baseline is necessary but not sufficient: the reliability table must also be monotone, otherwise the probability cannot be used for staking.

G-04.name: Line accuracy vs. naive baselines
G-04.registered_rule: Mean absolute error of our spread must beat BOTH baselines: (a) 0.0 spread, (b) raw point-differential-per-game, by >= 0.30 points.
G-04.measured: our MAE 12.17 pts vs baseline (a) 0.0-spread 13.27 (gain +1.09) and baseline (b) raw point differential 15.19 (gain +3.02)
G-04.required: beat BOTH baselines by >= 0.30 points of MAE
G-04.dispute_reason: Model fails to beat baseline (c), a shrunk differential with no home-court term: 12.09 vs 12.17 MAE (home-court gain -0.08 pts). The registered gate compares against an unshrunk baseline that is wrong by construction in week one, so this PASS is a false positive and must not be counted as evidence of skill.
G-04.strawman_warning: Baseline (b) is an unshrunk raw differential and is a strawman: in week one it reads up to -66 points, so it is wrong by construction and any sane model beats it. Baseline (c) applies the same shrinkage with no home-court term; the true gain over it is only -0.08 pts. Passing this gate on baseline (b) alone would be a false positive.
G-04.why_it_matters: Baseline (b) is the important one: if shrinkage and the home-court term do not beat a raw point differential, the model is decoration. This gate is the one that failed.

G-05.name: Luck removal
G-05.registered_rule: Bootstrap (10,000 resamples, fixed seed) 95% CI of ROI excludes 0; t-stat >= 2.0; and the luck-adjusted PnL (each bet replaced by its model-expected PnL, variance kept) must not reverse the sign.
G-05.measured: permutation test of the margin-error difference: diff -1.094, p 0.3483. ROI half is BLOCKED (no prices).
G-05.required: bootstrap 95% CI of ROI excludes 0 and t >= 2.0
G-05.why_it_matters: The luck question splits in two. Whether the *forecast* is better than naive can be answered without prices (done here, and the answer is 'not significantly'). Whether a *strategy* makes money needs prices (blocked).

G-06.name: Multiple-testing control
G-06.registered_rule: Across every strategy ever evaluated in the same window, apply Holm-Bonferroni to the CLV t-tests and require the Deflated Sharpe Ratio > 0.
G-06.measured: no CLV t-tests to correct; no complete trial ledger
G-06.required: Holm-Bonferroni across every strategy ever evaluated
G-06.why_it_matters: With 9 registered strategies and 4 tiers, the best-looking cell of this report is partly a search artifact. That is why no strategy is promoted on the strength of one number.

G-07.name: Walk-forward, no lookahead
G-07.registered_rule: Every feature timestamped at or before tip-off; train on the first 70% of the window, test on the final 30%; test MAE must not exceed full-window MAE by more than 25%.
G-07.required: test MAE not more than 25% worse than full-window MAE
G-07.why_it_matters: This gate was 'AT RISK by construction' on the old site because the only snapshot was a single as-of table that leaks the future. The backtest rebuilds every rating from games strictly before tip-off, and `assert_no_leakage` re-checks it, so the gate is now genuinely evaluable.
G-07.leakage_check: PASS (every graded game used only earlier games)

G-08.name: Parameter robustness
G-08.registered_rule: Re-price the slate over the full sensitivity box of every unratified parameter; a pick is only published if its side is unchanged in >= 90% of the grid.
G-08.measured: sigma swept 12.0-15.0, shrink K swept 6-24, HCA swept 0-3 pts
G-08.required: side unchanged in >= 90% of the parameter grid
G-08.why_it_matters: The model's accuracy barely moves across the grid, which means it is not over-tuned; it also means no setting makes it clearly better. Both facts are reported.

G-09.name: Cost and capacity
G-09.registered_rule: Survive -110 vig, 1% hard-cap stake, 25% Kelly, and a re-quote of the model at the reference price minus 0.25 points of expected slippage.
G-09.measured: no prices, so vig, slippage and Kelly sizing cannot be applied
G-09.required: positive after -110 vig, 1% cap, 25% Kelly, 0.25 pt slippage
G-09.why_it_matters: Stake sizing is impossible without a price. 0% stake is policy, not a placeholder.

G-10.name: Availability-adjustment guardrail
G-10.registered_rule: If a player on the official report with an Out/Doubtful status cannot be mapped to a quantified minutes delta, the line is published availability-blind and the game is marked INJURY-BLIND. No bet may be Tier A on an injury-blind game after the 13:00 ET report on game day.
G-10.measured: injury reports are not joined to this results history
G-10.required: no Tier A line on an injury-blind game after the 13:00 ET report
G-10.why_it_matters: Quantifying a status change needs player minutes, which the results snapshot does not carry. The gate cannot be scored, and no line in this backtest claims to be availability-adjusted.

summary.note: A gate in passed_disputed meets its registered wording but fails the stricter fair-baseline comparison, so it is not counted as evidence of skill and does not count toward the reward fraction.

leaderboard_notes: Ranked on deflated z, not on win rate. 155 graded games is far below the G-01 floor of 300 settled bets, so the ordering is provisional by construction.
Reward units are 0 for every strategy while any validation gate is FAILED. That is the gate doing its job, not a missing feature.
Strategies are mapped to confidence tiers before outcomes are seen, so a strategy cannot be re-labelled onto whichever tier happened to perform.
Every strategy here shares one model. Their results are therefore highly correlated and the leaderboard compares *filters on the same forecasts*, not independent systems.
